findings.note: She is the sole sponsor of H.855, An Act extending voting rights in municipal elections to noncitizen voters of the Commonwealth, referred to the Election Laws committee. Related topic: non-citizen voting. Filing date is the first history date shown on the bill page.

Sole petitioner of H.855, a bill to let noncitizens with legal immigration status vote in municipal elections only. The bill sets up a separate noncitizen registration form with a declaration of residency signed under pains and penalties of perjury, and bars noncitizen voting in federal and state races. Related topic: who is eligible to register and vote.

Lead petitioner of H.706 (2023-24 session), an earlier version of the bill extending municipal voting rights to noncitizens with legal immigration status. Related topic: who is eligible to register and vote.
